snippet_primary: > "The standard Paystack fee for local transactions is 1.5% + NGN 100 per transaction and 3.9% + NGN 100 for international transactions. Please check Paystack's pricing page for the latest updates. Note that these fees are collected by Paystack and do not go to Payhip."
subject_exact: Payhip help center (help.payhip.com/article/344-connecting-your-paystack-account, undated) states standard Paystack fee is 1.5% + NGN 100 per transaction for local transactions and 3.9% + NGN 100 for international transactions; fees collected by Paystack, not Payhip
local_qualifiers: Paystack fees: 1.5% + NGN 100 (local); 3.9% + NGN 100 (international); collected by Paystack not Payhip
